appeals.option_b: Merge both into one Joel 3:1-8 nations-lawsuit child and retain 3:4 internally.
appeals.preserved_disagreement: Hebrew/textual and canonical reviewers support the address split; literary review prefers the whole lawsuit and accepts the paired hold.
appeals.rationale: The general charges are concretized by named accusations and reciprocal verdict in 3:4-8, making autonomous retrieval materially contestable.
appeals.uncertainty: Whether a genuine direct-address seam creates an autonomous retrieval child.
